server.name: io.github.IvanBBaev/facebook-mcp

environmentVariables.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.
environmentVariables.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured. It belongs to exactly one Page, so set FB_PAGE_ID to that Page ID alongside it (the doctor / facebook_whoami reports it as the acting Page); a Page token without its Page ID is bound to nothing.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.
environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_ID

environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.
environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument. Required when FB_PAGE_TOKEN is the only credential: it names the Page that token belongs to.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_ID

environmentVariables.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.
environmentVariables.name: FB_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Marketing API version the ads tools target (ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, insights, async reports). The Marketing API retires versions on its own, shorter schedule, so it is pinned separately from FB_API_VERSION. Other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].
environmentVariables.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].
environmentVariables.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY

environmentVariables.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].
environmentVariables.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.
environmentVariables.name: FB_WRITE_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument. At least 16 characters — a shorter value fails startup; mint one with openssl rand -hex 32.
environmentVariables.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.
environmentVariables.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.
environmentVariables.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the small JSON file where facebook_get_activity_since keeps, per Page, the horizon of the last complete read. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path next to the journal; the file holds Page ids and timestamps only and is written atomically, owner-only (0600).
environmentVariables.name: FB_ACTIVITY_STATE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory where the insights tools write a CSV or JSON file when called with `output`. Defaults to `exports/` under the XDG/%APPDATA% state path. Files are written atomically and owner-only (0600) and are never overwritten; a name collision gets a numeric suffix.
environmentVariables.name: FB_EXPORT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.
environmentVariables.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages OR profiles to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them; deny wins over allow. Profile names expand here exactly as they do in FB_TOOL_PACKAGES, and a profile beats a same-spelled package, so FB_PACKAGES_DENY=core denies the whole six-package core profile rather than the single core package. The core package is then forced back on regardless, because its identity and diagnostic tools are what you need to debug the surface you just narrowed. An unrecognized name is a startup error, not a silently ignored token.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages OR profiles whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available. Profile names expand as they do in FB_TOOL_PACKAGES, so FB_PACKAGES_READONLY=core makes every default package read-only in one token. An unrecognized name is a startup error.
environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: FB_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it). At least 16 characters — a shorter value is refused (under stdio it is dropped with a warning); mint one with openssl rand -hex 32.
environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].
environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.
environmentVariables.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor units of the ad account's own currency (e.g. cents for USD). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused. No currency conversion: size it for the account's currency (1000 is $10 but only 1000 JPY).
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING

environmentVariables.description: Largest campaign spend_cap (the lifetime total a campaign may spend) that an ads write may set, in minor units of the ad account's own currency. Non-negative integer; a cap above it is refused, never clamped. Unset: every write that sets a campaign spend cap is refused. No currency conversion, same as FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING.
environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_CAMPAIGN_SPEND_CAP_MAX

environmentVariables.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.
environmentVariables.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.
environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.
environmentVariables.name: RERANK_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.
environmentVariables.name: WINDOWS_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.
environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.
environmentVariables.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.
environmentVariables.name: READONLY_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.
environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json (an empty folder there follows Obsidian's new-note location), falling back to "Daily Notes" when that file is missing or unreadable. Set to / for the vault root.
environmentVariables.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".
environmentVariables.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT

environmentVariables.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS

environmentVariables.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.
environmentVariables.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.
environmentVariables.name: TZ

environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes; none when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, overrides the default entirely.
environmentVariables.name: PROTECTED_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: the daily notes folder, "Templates", and MEMORY_DIR. DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER wins; otherwise .obsidian/daily-notes.json is read per query (fallback "Daily Notes"; no daily folder when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, replaces the defaults entirely. Set to a comma (,) to exclude nothing; an empty value uses the defaults.
environmentVariables.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS

environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.
environmentVariables.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL

environmentVariables.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES

runtimeArguments.description: Publish the container's port 8000 on the host.
runtimeArguments.name: -p

runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount your Obsidian vault into the container at /vault.
runtimeArguments.name: -v

VAULT_PATH.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault on the host machine.

headers.name: Authorization

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one LLM judge call (default 0.25); max_cost_usd can lower it for a call, never raise it
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL

environmentVariables.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: What every judge call together may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1): the relevance judge, evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations. Past it no judge call is made
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD

environmentVariables.description: The name of IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD before 0.21.0. Read when the new name is unset, and it then limits every judge call
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD

environmentVariables.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST

environmentVariables.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_REDACT

environmentVariables.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default); a tool argument can turn it off for a call, never on
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD

environmentVariables.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT

environmentVariables.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on); a tool argument can narrow it, never add to it
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS

environmentVariables.description: The most one verify_citations call may spend on judge calls, in USD (default 1); max_cost_usd_total can lower it, never raise it
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_MAX_COST_USD_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: The most array elements and object keys one input may hold before it is validated (default 100000): a tool call's arguments, and a dashboard or OTLP JSON request body. A tool call over it gets an error result; a body, 413. OTLP protobuf has its own ceiling, one element per 5 bytes of the request size limit
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS

environmentVariables.description: The name of IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS before 0.21.0, read when the new name is unset
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_MAX_TOOL_INPUT_ELEMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS

environmentVariables.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_URL

environmentVariables.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIRS

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of glob patterns for files to keep out of the index, each matched against the file's path relative to its root (e.g. '["plugs/**","**/*.draft.md"]').
environmentVariables.name: IGNORE_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)
environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).
environmentVariables.name: HF_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).
environmentVariables.name: STORE_IMAGES

environmentVariables.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX

environmentVariables.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX

environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT

environmentVariables.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD

environmentVariables.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
